coverage_rule: Every original concept_checks verdict not exactly the string 已足夠; include qualified 已足夠 verdicts as well as unknown/deferred.
method: Manual individual final-status/reason/evidence authored from my own already-read main notes, exact source quotes and bounded W.1. Program only checks exact quote membership and reference completeness; it does not generate statuses or rewrite original notes.
unverified_kept: Model/source empirical checks, execution on real environments and real Colab remain unverified as individually described.
